Projects 
 
 Project: Real-Time Pricing & Portfolio Valuation Dashboard | Franklin Templeton  
 
Overview: Delivered a real-time market pricing and portfolio valuation platform consolidating multi-source data from Bloomberg and ICE to support 
Front Office investment decision-making across Equities, Derivatives, and Fixed Income asset classes benchmarking portfolio performance against 
market competitors including JPMC." 
Problem Statement: The existing pricing process relied on manual data collection from multiple market data sources (Bloomberg, ICE), causing delays 
in portfolio valuation, inefficient Front Office analyst workflows, and limited real-time market visibility across asset classes. 
Key Contributions: 
• Led end-to-end Business Analyst responsibilities for a real-time pricing dashboard from requirements gathering through UAT enabling 
portfolio valuation benchmarking against market peers including JPMC across equity and fixed income instruments. 
• Gathered requirements from 15–20 pricing analysts, delivering BRD and data mapping documentation 
• Consolidated historical market data from Bloomberg & ICE; performed SQL-based data validation and reconciliation 
• Defined dashboard requirements and designed Power BI reports with 15-min auto-refresh, improving pricing accuracy by 18% and team 
efficiency by 60% 
• Followed Agile delivery across iterative cycles sprint planning, backlog grooming, and stakeholder walkthroughs with pricing, risk, and 
compliance teams 
Tools: SQL | Power BI | Bloomberg Terminal| ICE Data Services| Advanced Excel | Confluence | Jira 
 Project: Supply Chain Finance & Trade Digitization Platform Client: Mars Inc. | Yash Technology  
 
Overview: Mars Inc.'s global supplier payment lifecycle spanning PO management, shipment tracking, Letter of Credit issuance, and bank settlement 
was fragmented across enterprise ERP platforms, third -party logistics systems, and banking portals across 15+ countries, with no unified integration 
layer connecting supply chain operations to trade finance workflows. 
Problem Statement: No unified integration layer existed between Mars's supply chain and their trade finance workflows. LC issuance required manual 
bank communication, supplier KYC onboarding was entirely paper -based, and finance teams maintained parallel Excel trackers with zero real -time 
transaction visibility resulting in payment delays of 3-5 business days, high reconciliation error rates, and significant compliance risk. 
Key Contributions: 
• Executed As-Is & To-Be state analysis across the supplier lifecycle from PO creation through LC issuance, KYC validation, and payment 
settlement eliminating 14 manual intervention points via API-driven automation 
• Gathered end-to-end business requirements through stakeholder workshops with procurement, treasury, compliance, and banking teams 
delivering BRD, FRD, User Stories, and RTM covering 120+ functional requirements 
• Authored REST API integration specifications across enterprise ERP, logistics, and banking trade finance portal defining JSON payload 
structures, endpoint contracts, secure authentication flows, and error handling rules 
• Documented KYC/AML validation workflow requirements covering sanctions screening logic, risk-scoring rules, and compliance flag triggers 
ensuring regulatory alignment across 5 jurisdictions and reducing manual compliance effort by 70% 
• Defined and executed UAT test scenarios for LC issuance, payment events, KYC flows, and reconciliation edge cases validated 80+ API 
integrations in Postman, achieving zero critical defects at go-live. 
Tools: SQL | Power BI | Postman | Jira | Confluence | Lucidchart | Advanced Excel | JSON/XML | REST API|Python
